purpose: Hands over a floral artwork. The art is the face; the hands exist to stay legible over it, not to decorate it.

night.recipe: The artwork has no night variant, so the palette reaches it as a veil: a --face-bg wash at 0.22 over the whole disc, on a --face-bg ground, lifting by day and dimming at night. The art's own hues are untouched.

options.intent: The hand colour; pick for contrast against the artwork, never to match it.
cast is the point of this face: white hands over a mid-tone artwork read as floating rather than painted on. soft is fastclock only.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not add ticks or numerals over the artwork
antiPatterns.why: the art carries the composition and marks fight it
